role: Paired regression on exposed PR19 noise. Not new clinical or holdout validation.
analyzer: src/engine/sample-analysis.ts (current worker entry, before model audit)
toleranceRationale: Numerical reproducibility slack, well below the existing engineering review flags. Not physiological or clinical accuracy tolerances.
morphologyGate: Per preset/noise/SNR/filter/beat-kind/lead: mean, type7 p95 and maximum absolute error may not worsen beyond numerical slack. Native and post-acquisition chains separate. RMSE checked separately.
qualityGate: Within each preset/noise/SNR/filter stratum: no increase in usable erroneous estimates, no loss of usable-correct or retained-correct observations, no extra unreferenced outputs. Review retains the number and is NOT abstention. QRS/QT use paired beat errors with global status.
detectionGate: No loss of TP or increase in FP/FN with identical reference denominators.
integrityGate: Exact clean-source and noise identities, unchanged windows/protocol, complete unique scenarios, 12 leads and finite metrics. Missing values cannot become zero errors.
baselinePolicy: Never auto-regenerate the baseline to fix a red check. Intentional source changes or performance tradeoffs require an explicit reviewed amendment and rerun; retain the previous evidence.

monitorRevision.role: Explicit monitor-only migration selected using exposed development. Not preregistered clinical evidence. Preserve complete strict failures and old baseline.
